description: FREE, no API key. Recommend the optimal structure for an autonomous AI agent business: the US$299 Wyoming LLC (the fast, bank-friendly wedge — most agents start here), the Nevis LLC "Agent Company" (asset-protection fortress + 0% tax on non-Nevis income), or Nevis + a wholly-owned Wyoming USD subsidiary when the agent needs fiat rails (Stripe, US banking). Also flags a Delaware C-corp holding if the founder will raise equity. Advisory only, nothing stored — run agent_company_diagnostic first for the exposure score, then this for the structure, then create_standalone_company or create_formation_request to act.

agent_activity.description: What the AI agent does — e.g. "autonomous market-making", "runs ad campaigns and collects commissions".

holds_assets.description: Whether the agent holds significant treasury/assets (informational — the Nevis fortress already applies).

needs_fiat_usd.description: Does the agent need to receive USD/fiat or card payments (Stripe), or US banking? If true, a Wyoming subsidiary is recommended. Most crypto-only agents leave this false.

raising_equity_capital.description: Will the founder raise venture/equity capital from investors? If true, a Delaware C-corp holding is flagged.

name: recommend_structure
